reason: The factorization measurements time compiled FactorService requests, excluding module initialization and kernel replay. powModNatGo and powModWordOdd are byte-identical to the baseline. The old powModNat runtime body is preserved verbatim as powModBits; powMod changes only its two fallback references to this renamed definition. The existing powModNat_eq_powMod compiler-simplification theorem still routes compiled callers of powModNat through powMod, and the new implemented_by annotation points to that same runtime implementation. The new window and accumulator definitions are noncomputable kernel workers; they are not executed by this compiled service. The remaining changes are proofs, documentation and attribution. This exemption preserves the native factorization observations only; kernel performance is separately remeasured in reports/hex-primality-windowed-replay.md.
